objective: Measure Doré's present design ability through a real, constrained New Westside benchmark rather than through technical PASS alone.
user_intent: 看看現在多雷的設計水平如何

brief.content_principle: The design must make the relationship among Journal, ONE, Church, Library and Join understandable; beauty may not hide IA failure.

execute_now: Generate at least six materially distinct homepage experiment families from the same real content.
At least four families must use fundamentally different composition/interaction models, not merely different style skins.

Challenge the current design grammar. Include meaningful contrast across image-led vs type-led vs spatial/architectural, dense editorial vs contemplative, continuous narrative vs portal/city, static print-derived vs motion/interaction-led, monumental vs intimate, classical vs contemporary bilingual typography.
Do not automatically reuse the dominant dark-green/gold, giant serif hero, ruled-grid, or current threshold-spine grammar. Reuse only when independently justified by the concept.
Use real Westside copy and the five real destinations in every serious candidate.
Render each concept in a real browser at desktop 1440x1000 and mobile 390x844.
Collect render, responsive, semantic, visual-stability and basic accessibility evidence.
For every concept, state one strong design idea, one weakness, one rejected pattern, and one reason it is materially distinct from every other concept.
Run an explicit diversity audit across structure, hierarchy, typography, image system, motion/interaction, information architecture and mobile transformation.
Do not select a winner. The purpose is to expose present design range and quality, not converge.

must_demonstrate: distinct mobile composition rather than desktop collapse
visual identity appropriate to Westside without assuming current experiments are correct
ability to reject weak ideas, not merely produce variants
failure_conditions: six concepts are mostly palette/font swaps
all concepts inherit the same hero-plus-cards skeleton
technical browser PASS is presented as design-quality PASS
current three promoted Storybook candidates are recycled as the benchmark set
no explicit self-critique or diversity evidence

required_result.status: PASS only when the benchmark actually demonstrates design range with browser evidence
evidence: desktop and mobile evidence for each
explicit statement that product_acceptance=false and style_acceptance=false
rank the demonstrated capability dimensions without choosing a production winner
